ch_vocab_a2_01.title: Travel & Vacation
ch_vocab_a2_01.theory:
## Travel Vocabulary

Traveling is one of the most practical situations where you need Spanish. Let's learn the key vocabulary for airports, hotels, and travel planning.

### At the Airport (En el aeropuerto)
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el aeropuerto** | airport |
| **el vuelo** | flight |
| **el equipaje** | luggage |
| **la maleta** | suitcase |
| **el pasaporte** | passport |
| **el billete / el boleto** | ticket |
| **la tarjeta de embarque** | boarding pass |
| **facturar** | to check in (luggage) |
| **embarcar** | to board |

### At the Hotel (En el hotel)
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el hotel** | hotel |
| **la habitación** | room |
| **la reserva** | reservation |
| **reservar** | to reserve / كتاب |
| **la llave / tarjeta** | key / key card |

### Useful Travel Phrases
- **¿Tiene habitación libre?** — Do you have a room available?
- **Quisiera reservar una habitación doble.** — I would like to كتاب a double room.
- **El vuelo sale a las ocho.** — The flight leaves at eight.
- **¿Dónde está la puerta de embarque?** — Where is the boarding gate?
- **Necesito facturar mi equipaje.** — I need to check in my luggage.

### billete vs boleto
In Spain, people say **el billete** for ticket, while in Latin America, **el boleto** is more common. Both are correct and widely understood.
key_points: el aeropuerto, el vuelo, el equipaje — essential airport words
billete (Spain) vs boleto (Latin America) — both mean ticket
Quisiera reservar... — polite way to make a reservation
facturar = to check in luggage, embarcar = to board

vocab_list.example_meaning: We arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.

vocab_list.example: Mi equipaje pesa veinte kilos.
vocab_list.example_meaning: My luggage weighs twenty kilos.

vocab_list.example: Tengo una reserva a nombre de García.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I have a reservation under the name García.

vocab_list.example: No olvides tu pasaporte en el hotel.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Don't forget your passport at the hotel.

vocab_list.example: Me encanta viajar a otros países.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I حب traveling to other countries.

ch_vocab_a2_02.title: Health & Hospital
ch_vocab_a2_02.theory:
## Health Vocabulary

Knowing how to describe health problems is essential, especially when visiting a doctor or pharmacy in a Spanish-speaking country.

### Medical Places and People
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el médico / el doctor** | doctor |
| **la enfermera** | nurse |
| **el hospital** | hospital |
| **la farmacia** | pharmacy |
| **la consulta** | doctor's office / appointment |

### Symptoms and Illnesses
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la fiebre** | fever |
| **el dolor** | pain |
| **la gripe** | flu |
| **el resfriado** | cold |
| **la tos** | cough |

### Medicine
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la receta** | prescription |
| **la pastilla / la medicina** | pill / medicine |
| **recetar** | to prescribe |
| **toser** | to cough |
| **estornudar** | to sneeze |

### Using 'doler' (to hurt)
The verb **doler** works like **gustar** — the body part is the subject:
- **Me duele la cabeza.** — My head hurts. (lit. The head hurts to me.)
- **Me duele el estómago.** — My stomach hurts.
- **Me duelen las piernas.** — My legs hurt. (plural → duelen)

### Useful Phrases at the Doctor
- **Tengo fiebre / tos / gripe.** — I have a fever / cough / flu.
- **Necesito ir al médico.** — I need to go to the doctor.
- **¿Qué le pasa?** — What's wrong with you? (formal)
- **Tiene que tomar esta medicina tres veces al día.** — You have to take this medicine three times a day.
key_points: doler works like gustar: Me duele la cabeza (my head hurts)
Use duele (singular) or duelen (plural) depنهاية on the body part
Tengo fiebre/tos/gripe — use tener for symptoms
la receta = prescription, recetar = to prescribe

vocab_list.example: Necesito ir al médico, me siento mal.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I need to go to the doctor, I feel bad.

vocab_list.example: Compré las pastillas en la farmacia.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I bought the pills at the pharmacy.

vocab_list.example: El niño tiene mucha fiebre.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The child has a high fever.

vocab_list.example: Me duele mucho la espalda.
vocab_list.example_meaning: My back hurts a lot.

vocab_list.example: El médico me dio una receta para la medicina.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The doctor gave me a prescription for the medicine.

ch_vocab_a2_03.title: Sports & Hobbies
ch_vocab_a2_03.theory:
## Sports and Hobbies Vocabulary

Talking about sports and hobbies is a great way to connect with people. Spanish uses specific الأفعال depالنهاية on the activity.

### Common Sports (Deportes comunes)
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el fútbol** | soccer / football |
| **el baloncesto** | basketball |
| **la natación** | swimming |
| **el tenis** | tennis |
| **el ciclismo** | cycling |

### Sports الأفعال
| Verb | Usage |
|---|---|
| **jugar a** | for team/ball sports: jugar al fútbol |
| **practicar** | for general sports: practicar natación |
| **correr** | to run |
| **nadar** | to swim |

### Hobbies (Pasatiempos)
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **pintar** | to paint |
| **cocinar** | to cook |
| **bailar** | to dance |
| **leer** | to read |
| **tocar (un instrumento)** | to play (an instrument) |

### jugar vs practicar vs tocar
- **Jugar a** + team/ball sport: Juego **al** fútbol. (I play soccer.)
- **Practicar** + individual sport: Practico **natación**. (I practice swimming.)
- **Tocar** + instrument: Toco **la guitarra**. (I play guitar.)

### Using gustar/encantar with Hobbies
- **Me gusta pintar.** — I like to paint.
- **Me encanta bailar.** — I حب to dance.
- **Mi pasatiempo favorito es cocinar.** — My favorite hobby is cooking.

### Competition Words
- **el equipo** — team
- **el partido** — match / game
- **ganar** — to win
- **perder** — to lose
key_points: jugar al + team sport (fútbol), practicar + individual sport (natación)
tocar + instrument: Toco la guitarra (I play guitar)
Use gustar/encantar + infinitive for hobbies: Me gusta pintar
el partido = match/game, el equipo = team

vocab_list.example: Juego al fútbol los sábados.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I play soccer on Saturdays.

vocab_list.example: Me gusta nadar en la piscina.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I like to swim in the pool.

vocab_list.example: El partido empieza a las cinco.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The match starts at five.

vocab_list.example: Nuestro equipo ganó el partido.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Our team won the match.

vocab_list.example_meaning: My favorite hobby is painting.

ch_vocab_a2_04.title: Shopping & Prices
ch_vocab_a2_04.theory:
## Shopping Vocabulary

Shopping in Spanish-speaking countries requires knowing how to ask about prices, sizes, and payment methods.

### Places to Shop
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la tienda** | store / shop |
| **el supermercado** | supermarket |
| **el centro comercial** | shopping mall |
| **el mercado** | market |

### Prices and Payment
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el precio** | price |
| **la oferta / la rebaja** | sale / discount |
| **caro** | expensive |
| **barato** | cheap |
| **pagar** | to pay |
| **la tarjeta de crédito** | credit card |
| **el efectivo** | cash |

### Shopping الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **comprar** | to buy |
| **vender** | to sell |
| **probar(se)** | to try (on) |
| **devolver** | to return (an item) |

### Clothing Sizes
- **la talla** — size (for clothes)
- **el número** — size (for shoes)

### Essential Shopping Phrases
- **¿Cuánto cuesta?** / **¿Cuánto vale?** — How much does it cost?
- **¿Tiene una talla más grande / pequeña?** — Do you have a bigger / smaller size?
- **¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta?** — Can I pay by card?
- **Está en oferta / rebaja.** — It's on sale.
- **Me lo llevo.** — I'll take it.
- **¿Puedo probármelo?** — Can I try it on?
- **Quisiera devolver esto.** — I would like to return this.
key_points: ¿Cuánto cuesta? / ¿Cuánto vale? — How much does it cost?
la talla = clothing size, el número = shoe size
caro = expensive, barato = cheap, la oferta/rebaja = sale
probarse = to try on (reflexive): ¿Puedo probármelo?

vocab_list.example: Hay una tienda de ropa en la esquina.
vocab_list.example_meaning: There is a clothing store on the corner.

vocab_list.example: El precio es muy bueno.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The price is very جيد.

vocab_list.example: Este vestido es bonito y barato.
vocab_list.example_meaning: This dress is pretty and cheap.

vocab_list.example: Quiero devolver esta camisa porque es pequeña.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I want to return this shirt because it's صغير.

vocab_list.example: ¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta de crédito?
vocab_list.example_meaning: Can I pay with a credit card?

ch_vocab_a2_05.title: Restaurant & Ordering
ch_vocab_a2_05.theory:
## Restaurant Vocabulary

Eating out is a central part of Spanish culture. Knowing the right phrases will make your dining experience much smoother.

### People and Places
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el camarero / la camarera** | waiter / waitress |
| **el menú / la carta** | menu |
| **la mesa** | طاولة |
| **la terraza** | terrace / outdoor seating |

### The Meal Structure
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el primer plato** | first course / starter |
| **el segundo plato** | second course / main |
| **el postre** | dessert |
| **la bebida** | drink |
| **la cuenta** | the bill / check |
| **la propina** | tip |

### Ordering الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **pedir** | to order / ask for |
| **recomendar** | to recommend |
| **reservar** | to reserve |

### Useful Restaurant Phrases
- **Quisiera... / Me gustaría...** — I would like...
- **Para mí, el pollo, por favor.** — For me, the chicken, من فضلك.
- **De primer plato, la sopa.** — For the first course, the soup.
- **De segundo, el pescado.** — For the second course, the fish.
- **¿Nos trae la cuenta, por favor?** — Could you bring us the bill, من فضلك?
- **¿Qué nos recomienda?** — What do you recommend?
- **¡Buen provecho!** — Enjoy your meal! (Bon appétit!)

### Tipping in Spain
In Spain, tipping is not obligatory but appreciated. A صغير tip of 5-10% or rounding up is common. In Latin America, customs vary by country.
key_points: Quisiera... / Me gustaría... — polite ways to order
De primer plato... De segundo... — ordering course by course
¿Nos trae la cuenta? — asking for the bill
¡Buen provecho! — said before eating (like Bon appétit)

vocab_list.example: El camarero nos trajo el menú.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The waiter brought us the menu.

vocab_list.example: Voy a pedir la paella.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I am going to order the paella.

vocab_list.example_meaning: Could you bring us the bill, من فضلك?

vocab_list.example_meaning: For dessert, I want flan.

ch_vocab_a2_06.title: مدينة & Directions
ch_vocab_a2_06.theory:
## مدينة and Directions Vocabulary

Navigating a مدينة is one of the most important practical skills. Learn how to ask for and give directions in Spanish.

### مدينة Places
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la calle** | street |
| **la plaza** | square / plaza |
| **la esquina** | corner |
| **el semáforo** | traffic light |
| **el cruce** | intersection / crossroads |
| **el banco** | bank |
| **la iglesia** | church |
| **el museo** | museum |
| **el ayuntamiento** | town hall / مدينة hall |

### Direction Words
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **a la derecha** | to the right |
| **a la izquierda** | to the left |
| **seguir recto / todo recto** | to go straight |
| **girar** | to turn |
| **cerca (de)** | near / close (to) |
| **lejos (de)** | far (from) |

### Location حروف الجر
- **al lado de** — next to
- **enfrente de** — in front of / across from
- **entre** — between
- **detrás de** — behind
- **delante de** — in front of

### Asking for Directions
- **¿Cómo llego a...?** — How do I get to...?
- **¿Dónde está el museo?** — Where is the museum?
- **Perdone, ¿sabe dónde está...?** — Excuse me, do you know where... is?

### Giving Directions
- **Siga recto dos calles.** — Go straight for two blocks.
- **Gire a la derecha en el semáforo.** — Turn right at the traffic light.
- **Está al lado del banco.** — It's next to the bank.
- **Está enfrente de la iglesia.** — It's across from the church.
key_points: ¿Cómo llego a...? — the standard way to ask for directions
siga recto = go straight, gire a la derecha/izquierda = turn right/left
Location prepositions: al lado de, enfrente de, entre, detrás de
el semáforo = traffic light, la esquina = corner, el cruce = intersection

vocab_list.example: Mi casa está en la calle Mayor.
vocab_list.example_meaning: My منزل is on Mayor Street.

vocab_list.example: Gire a la izquierda en la esquina.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Turn left at the corner.

vocab_list.example: El supermercado está muy cerca de aquí.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The supermarket is very close to here.

vocab_list.example: La farmacia está enfrente del banco.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The pharmacy is across from the bank.

vocab_list.example: Siga recto hasta el semáforo.
vocab_list.example_meaning: Go straight until the traffic light.

ch_vocab_a2_07.title: Housework & Chores
ch_vocab_a2_07.theory:
## Housework Vocabulary

Talking about daily household chores is essential for everyday life in Spanish. Most housework vocabulary uses regular الأفعال.

### Cleaning Tasks
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **limpiar** | to clean |
| **barrer** | to sweep |
| **fregar (los platos)** | to wash (the dishes) |
| **pasar la aspiradora** | to vacuum |
| **ordenar** | to tidy up |
| **recoger** | to pick up / tidy |

### Laundry and Ironing
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **lavar la ropa** | to do the laundry |
| **tender la ropa** | to hang out the laundry |
| **planchar** | to iron |
| **la lavadora** | washing machine |

### Other Chores
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **cocinar** | to cook |
| **hacer la cama** | to make the bed |
| **sacar la basura** | to take out the trash |
| **poner la mesa** | to set the طاولة |
| **quitar la mesa** | to clear the طاولة |

### Useful Phrases
- **Tengo que limpiar la casa.** — I have to clean the منزل.
- **¿Me ayudas a fregar los platos?** — Can you help me wash the dishes?
- **Es tu turno de sacar la basura.** — It's your turn to take out the trash.
- **Voy a pasar la aspiradora.** — I'm going to vacuum.
- **Ya he hecho la cama.** — I've already made the bed.

### Note: hacer + Chores
Many chores use **hacer** (to do/make): hacer la cama, hacer la colada (do laundry, Spain), hacer la compra (do the grocery shopping).
key_points: fregar = to wash dishes (Spain), lavar los platos (Latin America)
pasar la aspiradora = to vacuum (lit. pass the vacuum cleaner)
Many chores use hacer: hacer la cama, hacer la compra
Tengo que + infinitive for obligation: Tengo que limpiar

vocab_list.example_meaning: I have to clean the kitchen.

vocab_list.example_meaning: Can you sweep the floor?

ch_vocab_a2_08.title: Technology & Internet Basics
ch_vocab_a2_08.theory:
## Technology Vocabulary

Technology vocabulary is essential in modern life. Spanish has some مثير للاهتمام regional differences for tech terms.

### Devices
| Spanish (Spain) | Spanish (Latin America) | English |
|---|---|---|
| **el ordenador** | **la computadora** | computer |
| **el teléfono móvil** | **el teléfono celular** | cell phone |
| **la tableta** | **la tableta** | tablet |

### Computer Parts
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la pantalla** | screen |
| **el teclado** | keyboard |
| **el ratón** | mouse |
| **el disco duro** | hard drive |

### Internet and Software
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **internet** | internet |
| **el correo electrónico** | email |
| **la contraseña** | password |
| **la aplicación / la app** | application / app |
| **la página web** | website / web page |
| **el navegador** | browser |

### Tech الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **descargar** | to download |
| **buscar** | to search |
| **enviar** | to send |
| **guardar** | to save |
| **borrar / eliminar** | to delete |

### Useful Phrases
- **Enviar un correo electrónico** — To send an email
- **Descargar una aplicación** — To download an app
- **¿Cuál es tu contraseña?** — What is your password?
- **Mi ordenador no funciona.** — My computer doesn't work.
- **¿Tienes wifi?** — Do you have wifi?

### Spain vs Latin America
The biggest differences in tech vocabulary are **ordenador** (Spain) vs **computadora** (Latin America) and **móvil** (Spain) vs **celular** (Latin America). Both variants are understood everywhere.
key_points: ordenador (Spain) vs computadora (Latin America) = computer
móvil (Spain) vs celular (Latin America) = cell phone
descargar = to download, enviar = to send, buscar = to search
la contraseña = password, la página web = website

ch_vocab_a2_09.title: Festivals & Celebrations
ch_vocab_a2_09.theory:
## Festivals and Celebrations Vocabulary

Spanish-speaking countries have rich traditions and celebrations. Learning this vocabulary helps you participate in cultural events.

### Celebrations
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la fiesta** | party / festival |
| **la Navidad** | Christmas |
| **la boda** | wedding |
| **el cumpleaños** | birthday |
| **la Nochevieja** | New Year's Eve |
| **la Semana Santa** | Holy Week / Easter |

### Celebration Items
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el regalo** | gift / المضارع |
| **el pastel / la tarta** | cake |
| **la decoración** | decoration |
| **la vela** | candle |
| **el globo** | balloon |

### Celebration الأفعال
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **celebrar** | to celebrate |
| **felicitar** | to congratulate |
| **invitar** | to invite |
| **brindar** | to toast / make a toast |
| **regalar** | to give a gift |

### Common Expressions
- **¡Felicidades!** — Congratulations!
- **¡Feliz cumpleaños!** — سعيد birthday!
- **¡Feliz Navidad!** — Merry Christmas!
- **¡Feliz Año Nuevo!** — سعيد New Year!
- **¡Enhorabuena!** — Congratulations! (for achievements)

### Famous Spanish Celebrations
- **La Tomatina** — Tomato-throwing festival in Buñol, Spain (August)
- **San Fermín** — Running of the bulls in Pamplona, Spain (July)
- **Día de los Muertos** — Day of the Dead in Mexico (November 1-2)
- **Las Fallas** — Fire festival in Valencia, Spain (March)
- **Carnaval** — Carnival celebrations across Latin America
key_points: ¡Felicidades! = Congratulations, ¡Feliz cumpleaños! = Happy birthday
el pastel (Latin America) vs la tarta (Spain) = cake
brindar = to toast, felicitar = to congratulate, regalar = to give a gift
Famous festivals: La Tomatina, San Fermín, Día de los Muertos

ch_vocab_a2_10.title: الحيوانات
ch_vocab_a2_10.theory:
## Animals and Nature Vocabulary

Learning animal vocabulary is fun and practical. Spanish distinguishes between domestic, farm, and wild animals.

### Pets (Mascotas)
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el perro** | dog |
| **el gato** | cat |
| **el conejo** | rabbit |
| **el pez** | fish (alive) |
| **el pájaro** | bird |
| **la mascota** | pet |

### Farm Animals (Animales de granja)
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la vaca** | cow |
| **el cerdo** | pig |
| **la gallina** | hen / chicken |
| **el caballo** | horse |
| **la oveja** | sheep |

### Wild Animals (Animales salvajes)
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el león** | lion |
| **la serpiente** | snake |
| **la mariposa** | butterfly |
| **el mono** | monkey |
| **el oso** | bear |

### Describing Animals
Use **ser** for permanent characteristics and **tener** for features:
- El perro **es** grande y marrón. — The dog is big and brown.
- El gato **tiene** ojos verdes. — The cat has green eyes.
- La serpiente **es** peligrosa. — The snake is dangerous.

### Animal-related الصفات
- **doméstico** — domestic
- **salvaje** — wild
- **peligroso** — dangerous
- **manso** — tame / gentle

### Useful Phrases
- **Tengo un perro como mascota.** — I have a dog as a pet.
- **Mi animal favorito es el caballo.** — My favorite animal is the horse.
- **Los gatos son muy independientes.** — Cats are very independent.
- **En el zoo hay muchos animales salvajes.** — In the zoo there are many wild animals.
key_points: el pez = fish (alive), el pescado = fish (as food)
Use ser for characteristics: Es grande. Use tener for features: Tiene ojos verdes
doméstico = domestic, salvaje = wild, peligroso = dangerous
Tengo un/una... como mascota = I have a ... as a pet

vocab_list.example: Mi perro se llama Max.
vocab_list.example_meaning: My كلب's name is Max.

vocab_list.example: El gato duerme en el sofá.
vocab_list.example_meaning: The قطة sleeps on the sofa.

vocab_list.example: Me gusta montar a caballo.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I like horseback riding.

vocab_list.example: Hay muchas mariposas en el jardín.

ch_vocab_a2_11.title: Physical Descriptions
ch_vocab_a2_11.theory:
## Physical Description Vocabulary

Describing people's appearance is a fundamental skill. Spanish uses specific الأفعال for different types of physical traits.

### Height and Build
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **alto/a** | tall |
| **bajo/a** | short |
| **gordo/a** | fat |
| **delgado/a** | thin / slim |
| **fuerte** | strong |
| **joven** | شاب |
| **viejo/a** / **mayor** | old / elderly |

### Face and General Appearance
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **guapo/a** | handsome / pretty |
| **feo/a** | ugly |
| **atractivo/a** | attractive |

### Hair (El pelo)
| لون | Type |
|---|---|
| **rubio** — blond | **liso** — straight |
| **moreno** — dark / brunette | **rizado** — curly |
| **pelirrojo** — redhead | **ondulado** — wavy |
| **canoso** — gray-haired | **largo / corto** — طويل / short |
| **calvo** — bald | |

### Eyes (Los ojos)
- **ojos azules** — blue eyes
- **ojos verdes** — green eyes
- **ojos marrones** — brown eyes
- **ojos negros** — black/dark eyes

### Accessories
- **llevar gafas** — to wear glasses
- **llevar barba** — to have a beard
- **llevar bigote** — to have a mustache

### Verb Usage: ser vs tener vs llevar
- **SER** for permanent traits: **Es** alto y delgado. (He is tall and thin.)
- **TENER** for features: **Tiene** el pelo rubio y los ojos azules. (She has blond hair and blue eyes.)
- **LLEVAR** for accessories/facial hair: **Lleva** gafas. (He wears glasses.)

### Example Description
Mi hermano **es** alto y moreno. **Tiene** el pelo corto y rizado. **Tiene** los ojos marrones. **Lleva** barba y gafas.
key_points: SER for body type: Es alto, es delgada, es joven
TENER for hair/eyes: Tiene el pelo rubio, tiene los ojos verdes
LLEVAR for accessories/facial hair: Lleva gafas, lleva barba
Hair types: liso (straight), rizado (curly), ondulado (wavy)

vocab_list.example_meaning: My father is very tall.

ch_vocab_a2_12.title: المشاعر
ch_vocab_a2_12.theory:
## Personality and Emotions Vocabulary

Describing someone's personality uses **ser** because personality traits are considered permanent characteristics.

### Positive Personality Traits
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **simpático/a** | nice / friendly |
| **amable** | kind |
| **generoso/a** | generous |
| **trabajador/a** | hardworking |
| **divertido/a** | fun / funny |
| **paciente** | patient |
| **optimista** | optimistic |
| **valiente** | brave |

### النفي Personality Traits
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **antipático/a** | unfriendly / unpleasant |
| **tímido/a** | shy |
| **vago/a / perezoso/a** | lazy |
| **serio/a** | serious |
| **impaciente** | impatient |
| **pesimista** | pessimistic |
| **celoso/a** | jealous |
| **orgulloso/a** | proud |

### Asking About Personality
- **¿Cómo es ella?** — What is she like? (personality)
- **¿Cómo está ella?** — How is she? (mood/state)

### ser vs estar with Personality
- **SER** for personality (permanent): Ella **es** simpática. (She is a nice person.)
- **ESTAR** for temporary mood: Ella **está** contenta hoy. (She is سعيد today.)

### Important Contrast
Some الصفات change meaning with ser vs estar:
- Es **aburrido** — He is boring (personality)
- Está **aburrido** — He is bored (temporary state)
- Es **listo** — He is clever
- Está **listo** — He is ready

### Describing Character
- **Es muy simpática y amable.** — She is very nice and kind.
- **Mi amigo es un poco tímido pero muy generoso.** — My صديق is a bit shy but very generous.
- **Es la persona más divertida que conozco.** — She is the funniest person I know.
key_points: Use SER for personality: Es simpática (she is nice — always)
Use ESTAR for mood: Está contenta (she is happy — right now)
¿Cómo es? = What is he/she like? vs ¿Cómo está? = How is he/she?
Some words change meaning: Es aburrido (boring) vs Está aburrido (bored)

ch_vocab_a2_13.title: Phone & Letters
ch_vocab_a2_13.theory:
## Phone and Letter Vocabulary

Phone conversations and letter writing have their own special vocabulary and conventions in Spanish.

### Phone Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **llamar (por teléfono)** | to call (on the phone) |
| **contestar** | to answer |
| **colgar** | to hang up |
| **el mensaje** | message |
| **dejar un recado** | to leave a message |
| **marcar (el número)** | to dial (the number) |

### Phone Greetings by Country
- **¿Diga? / ¿Dígame?** — مرحباً? (Spain)
- **¿Bueno?** — مرحباً? (Mexico)
- **¿Aló?** — مرحباً? (many Latin American countries)

### Phone Phrases
- **¿Está María?** — Is María there?
- **Un momento, por favor.** — One moment, من فضلك.
- **No está en este momento.** — She's not here right now.
- **¿Quiere dejar un recado?** — Would you like to leave a message?
- **Le llamo más tarde.** — I'll call you later. (formal)

### Letter Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la carta** | letter |
| **el sobre** | envelope |
| **el sello / la estampilla** | stamp |
| **el buzón** | mailbox |
| **la dirección** | address |
| **el remitente** | sender |
| **el destinatario** | recipient |

### Letter Format
**Saludo (Greeting):**
- **Querido/a...** — Dear... (informal)
- **Estimado/a Sr./Sra....** — Dear Mr./Mrs.... (formal)

**Despedida (Closing):**
- **Un saludo** / **Un abrazo** — Regards / A hug (informal)
- **Atentamente** / **Cordialmente** — Sincerely / Cordially (formal)
key_points: Phone greetings vary: ¿Diga? (Spain), ¿Bueno? (Mexico), ¿Aló? (Latin America)
dejar un recado = to leave a message, colgar = to hang up
Letter greeting: Querido/a (informal), Estimado/a (formal)
Letter closing: Un saludo (informal), Atentamente (formal)

vocab_list.example: Te llamo esta tarde.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I'll call you this afternoon.

vocab_list.example: Te he dejado un mensaje en el móvil.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I left you a message on your phone.

vocab_list.example: He escrito una carta a mi abuela.
vocab_list.example_meaning: I have written a letter to my grandmother.

vocab_list.example_meaning: Put the stamp on the envelope.

ch_vocab_a2_14.title: Bank & Post Office
ch_vocab_a2_14.theory:
## Bank and Post Office Vocabulary

Handling money and sالنهاية packages are important practical situations. Learn the key vocabulary for banks and post offices.

### Bank Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el banco** | bank |
| **la cuenta bancaria** | bank account |
| **el cajero automático** | ATM |
| **sacar / retirar dinero** | to withdraw money |
| **ingresar / depositar** | to deposit |
| **la transferencia** | transfer |
| **el préstamo** | loan |
| **los ahorros** | savings |
| **firmar** | to sign |
| **el formulario** | form |

### Post Office Vocabulary
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **correos** | post office |
| **el paquete** | package |
| **enviar** | to send |
| **recibir** | to receive |
| **la ventanilla** | counter / window |
| **hacer cola** | to wait in line / queue |
| **el envío** | shipment / delivery |
| **certificado** | certified / registered |

### At the Bank — Useful Phrases
- **Quisiera abrir una cuenta.** — I would like to open an account.
- **Necesito sacar dinero del cajero.** — I need to withdraw money from the ATM.
- **¿Puedo hacer una transferencia?** — Can I make a transfer?
- **¿Dónde tengo que firmar?** — Where do I need to sign?
- **Rellene este formulario, por favor.** — Fill out this form, من فضلك.

### At the Post Office — Useful Phrases
- **Quiero enviar este paquete a México.** — I want to send this package to Mexico.
- **¿Cuánto cuesta el envío?** — How much is the shipping?
- **¿Es urgente o normal?** — Is it urgent or standard?
- **Necesito cinco sellos.** — I need five stamps.
- **¿Cuánto tarda en llegar?** — How طويل does it take to arrive?
key_points: sacar/retirar dinero = withdraw, ingresar/depositar = deposit
el cajero automático = ATM, la cuenta bancaria = bank account
hacer cola = to wait in line, la ventanilla = counter/window
¿Cuánto cuesta el envío? — How much is the shipping?

ch_vocab_a2_15.title: Leisure & Entertainment
ch_vocab_a2_15.theory:
## Leisure and Entertainment Vocabulary

Talking about free الوقت and entertainment is essential for socializing in Spanish.

### Entertainment Places
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **el cine** | سينما / movie theater |
| **el teatro** | theater |
| **el concierto** | concert |
| **el museo** | museum |
| **la exposición** | exhibition |
| **el parque de atracciones** | amusement حديقة |

### Entertainment Types
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **la película** | movie / film |
| **la obra de teatro** | play (theater) |
| **la canción** | song |
| **la música** | music |
| **el espectáculo** | show / performance |

### Leisure الأفعال and Expressions
| Spanish | English |
|---|---|
| **divertirse** | to have fun |
| **aburrirse** | to get bored |
| **pasarlo bien** | to have a جيد الوقت |
| **pasarlo mal** | to have a bad الوقت |
| **el tiempo libre** | free الوقت |
| **el ocio** | leisure |

### Making Plans
- **¿Qué hacemos este fin de semana?** — What shall we do this weekend?
- **¿Vamos al cine?** — Shall we go to the سينما?
- **¿Te apetece ir al teatro?** — Do you feel like going to the theater?
- **¿Qué tipo de películas te gustan?** — What kind of movies do you like?
- **Me lo pasé muy bien.** — I had a great الوقت.
- **Fue muy divertido.** — It was a lot of fun.

### Movie Genres
- **una película de acción** — action movie
- **una comedia** — comedy
- **una película de terror** — horror movie
- **un documental** — documentary
- **una película romántica** — romantic movie

### Note: pasarlo bien/mal
This expression uses the pronoun **lo** and changes with the subject:
- **(Yo) me lo pasé bien.** — I had a جيد الوقت.
- **(Nosotros) nos lo pasamos genial.** — We had a great الوقت.
- **(Ella) se lo pasó mal.** — She had a bad الوقت.
key_points: divertirse = to have fun (reflexive), aburrirse = to get bored
pasarlo bien/mal = to have a good/bad time: Me lo pasé muy bien
¿Vamos al cine? / ¿Te apetece...? — suggesting plans
la película = movie, la obra de teatro = play, la canción = song
